title: Chapter 136 Still Need To Buy Wall Bricks
content:
Chapter 136 Still Need To Buy Wall Bricks

"Of course I bought it! And I have it here, and I'll give you a discount for larger quantities."

"You carry city wall bricks with you?" Wang Shuo raised his eyebrows and his eyes widened.

"After all, I rely on this to make a living, so of course I have to prepare some, but I'm afraid I don't have enough for the quantity you need."

He then said: "In addition to buying, there is another way to quickly make city wall bricks, but the firing time cannot be shortened."

"What method?"

"Use the construction acceleration scroll."

Wang Shuo thought of the many acceleration scrolls he had obtained when he cleaned up the battlefield before, so he took one out.

"It's this thing." Xiao Laoteng took the acceleration construction scroll and slapped it in his hands. He saw his hands moving so quickly that only the afterimage could be seen.

In a few breaths, he got dozens of city brick embryos.

Wang Shuo's eyes widened, his face full of incredible expressions.

The acceleration construction scroll can actually be used in this way!

Wang Shuo also tried it and was overjoyed.

"How many bricks do you have for the city wall? How much is one?"

"Not many, only 50,000, 2 gold coins per brick, friendly price."

"Oh my god, it's ridiculously expensive."

"Didn't you say that you'll get a discount for larger quantities?" Wang Shuo felt it was too expensive.

This industry is really lucrative.

"Uh!" Xiao Laoteng suddenly regretted saying this.

Now it's a seller's market, a unique business.

Xiao Laoteng narrowed his eyes, frowned and said: "How about this, I'll give you a 10% discount! That's good enough!"

"Damn, they're all profiteers." Wang Shuo was full of complaints.

Seeing Wang Shuo hesitate, he was afraid that the deal would fail, after all, the other party already had several people who could make city wall bricks.

"I'm also responsible for helping to lay the city wall bricks on the city wall!"

Wang Shuo sighed in his heart, frowned, and said decisively: "Deal."

While it was still light.

Wang Shuo called Yan Fujie to follow Xiao Laoteng and learn how to lay city wall bricks.

After a simple survey of the terrain.

Xiao Laoteng waved his hand, and a gully appeared out of thin air in front of him.

Wang Shuo was shocked again by his move.

Xiao Laoteng explained: "I first used the mud pit, then used the mud dilution to collect the silt inside."

"But I didn't see you add water, how to make a mud pit?"

"I was just faster!" Xiao Laoteng said lightly.

Damn!

You're pretending again!

"This step is called laying the foundation, and you must dig into stones or hard ground."

Then he took out the wall bricks, this black iron-grade wall brick, about 1 meter long, 40 centimeters wide and high.

Each rectangular surface has 2 defense symbols drawn on it, and 1 at each end.

"In this step, the most important thing is to align the seams of the defense runes."

"Don't you need cement or something?"

"No, these bricks are equivalent to magnets. As long as the gaps are aligned, they will connect to each other and become a whole."

Wang Shuo nodded.

As his hands kept moving, in a cup of tea, he built two 10-meter-high walls. The middle was temporarily hollow and needed to be filled with soil. The width was about 5 meters.

The walls of a general town are about 10 meters.

Such a town is enough for Wang Shuo's village to be upgraded to a town.

"How is it? Have you learned it?" Xiao Laoteng looked at Wang Shuo and asked.

Wang Shuo and Yan Fujie are both talented and good at doing this kind of thing.

"Well, I can give it a try." Yan Fujie said confidently.

Wang Shuo also took the wall bricks from Xiao Laoteng and started adding them to the wall.

It's like playing a jigsaw puzzle, but in 3D.

Soon the two of them mastered the skills.

It was getting dark, and they had to wait until tomorrow to continue.

There are still two days left, I hope everything is still in time!
